main_text.l: III. Omnis quoque juris & authoritatis il-
lius abolitio urgeri atque exprimi debet, quod
aut quae Amnestiae beneficio ac usui esse possit.
Nullum enim praesentis legis ac beneficii
publici post culpam majus est munimentum
quam omnis ejus rei speciatim expressa abro-
gatio, quae praesenti legi aut beneficio possit
facit, ut & tuta & minime dubia sit Amnestia;
& post eam hoc pacto sancitam, nihil Principi-
bus superfit, quo in subditos poenis possint

l.i: Divisa civitate per factiones & civilia bella, quod
interim ab una parte as alienum contrahitur,
an eadem civitate unita ab omnibus deberi

main_text.l: SCissi olim erant in factiones cives Athe-
Dominationis pertaesa in Pyraeum ut exules secesserunt

page.notes: Drop-cap "S" in the final paragraph; the last word "cesse-" is a catchword-like hyphenated line end, read as "cesse-" with the last syllable printed at the right margin as "cesse." Some words in the paragraph near the foot are faint and partly illegible; "in Pyraeum" and "ut exules" are uncertain readings. The first letter of the final paragraph is a decorative initial S with the rest of its word "Cissi" set beside it.
